non_claims: No proof is claimed for the producer, the host evaluator or the compiled backend: `disproved` rests only on the pinned Lean consumer accepting the reviewed refutation template instantiated at the candidate; the consumer and the MC1 library are explicit assumptions (VC-GATE-03).
